title: residency-aware-kms-fallback-and-rbac-probing-tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: We observed a partial outage last quarter when a regional KMS provider experienced intermittent availability, which caused tenant requests pinned to that provider to fail rather than failover. Motivation: provide a deterministic, auditable fallback for KMS selection while preserving tenant data-residency constraints and minimizing blast radius. This PR implements a residency-aware KMS selector with per-tenant provider allowlists and a prioritized fallback plan, an RBAC v2 probing endpoint for simulating policy decisions before rollout, and audit integrity chaining to prove key-selection decisions. High-level changes: 1) residency/kms: add residency-aware KMS allocator that consults tenant residency profile, provider health, and policy allowlists; supports multi-step fallback (primary -> regional partners -> staged emergency escrow) with TTL-bound ephemeral wrapping keys. 2) rbac/v2: add /internal/rbac/simulate endpoint that accepts an assertion payload and returns the PDP decision trace to preview how a change to role bindings would evaluate. 3) audit: append per-request KMS-signature pointers and an integrity HMAC of the KMS decision envelope to audit logs so audits can prove which KMS was selected and why. 4) migration/ops: add migration to extend tenant metadata schema with kms_allowlist and residency_tier; CLI tooling to backfill from policy engine and to run dry-run simulation. Security considerations: fallback respects tenant allowlists and tenant-level emergency consent flag; emergency escrow path requires explicit operator approval and is recorded in the immutable audit envelope. Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains unchanged unless tenant metadata is populated or feature-flag enabled. Rollout: feature-flag gated, staged canary to 5% of traffic, followed by region-by-region expansion with a 48h observation window per region. Linear/Jira: ENG-9123 implement selector, SEC-441 add audit-proofing. Checklist: - [x] selector prototype and unit tests - [x] RBAC simulate endpoint and integration tests - [x] audit envelope schema changes and log wiring - [x] migration and backfill CLI - [x] docs and runbook updates - [x] canary plan and rollout playbook - [x] add metrics (kms.selection.count, kms.fallback.count, rbac.simulate.latency) Related: policy linter changes in /tools/policy-lint to catch allowlist omissions. Risks & mitigations: KMS provider churn may increase latency during fallback; mitigated via optimistic async wrapping and cached ephemeral keys. Emergency escrow path limited by operator gating and additional HSM signing.
